existingLifecycle: Runner.group_activity already retries an incomplete group sample at most three times and retains partial observations.

Runner.run checks the exact Popen child after a terminal incomplete sample. If that child has exited, it proceeds to wait and group cleanup; it does not automatically label the expected exit monitor-unavailable.

A live stage with persistent unknown resource totals cannot satisfy the current complete-owned-RSS contract. Continuing it would require another trustworthy accounting or enforcement mechanism, not a role exemption or zero substitution.

recommendation.candidate: Use exported ordinary libproc PID enumeration, full BSD identity, executable path, and sysctl KERN_PROCARGS2 reads in the existing harness process, without spawning setuid census children.
recommendation.resourceMonitor: Keep target selection, complete/null resource semantics, retry count, limits, and safe cleanup unchanged.
recommendation.permissionFailure: Stop or report observation unavailable if ordinary APIs are denied; do not add sudo, entitlements, protection changes, or a privileged fallback.
recommendation.remainingScope: Other native utilities and genuine browser or Shim permission failures remain possible; this candidate removes only the two identified census producers.

requiredImplementationContracts: Keep all-process discovery and single-PID identity checks; do not replace exact argv/profile matching with process-name or path-only matching.

Preserve a full positive (PID,startSec,startUsec) identity and same effective UID. Read executable path and argv with before/after identity checks. Treat these as consistent snapshots, not atomic immunity to exec or exit races.

Use the argc count to parse exactly the argv entries with bounded buffers, complete NUL terminators, and byte-preserving path decoding. Do not include environment contents or raw launch tokens in public evidence.

Distinguish absence, mismatch, and unavailable evidence. proc_pidinfo errors return zero with errno; proc_listpids returns bytes whereas proc_listallpids returns PID count. Clear and retain errno, reject malformed sizes and saturated or truncated inventories.
Do not classify KERN_PROCARGS2 EINVAL as process exit: the kernel also uses it for credential mismatch and unavailable or inactive process state. Recheck identity to establish an exit or mismatch.
Retain ambiguity refusal, exact identity recheck before signalling, kqueue registration recheck, existing startup deadlines, and bounded iteration/buffer sizes.

Bind the overlay and any additional module to immutable hashes and update sparse checkout, verification, and SDK-free census tests. A direct API call deadline check is not a guarantee of cancellability inside the kernel.
rejectedShortcuts: Ignoring a system-ps role, a different owner, or a known exact child in resource totals.
Treating a short expected lifetime, successful later reap, or a measured lower bound as a complete total at the denied samples.
Moving helpers outside the target group without equivalent owned-process accounting and cleanup.
Suppressing sampling or adding unbounded lifecycle coordination or additional retries as a substitute for complete accounting.
minimumValidation: Portable parser/ABI/size/error tests for argc and argv, truncation, zero/error return values, identity changes, same PID with different birth, foreign owner, exact profile mismatch, and ambiguous discovery.

One bounded SDK-free macos-15-intel gate exercising all-process and single-PID reads, exact live child identity, an unreaped child, matching and nonmatching argv/profile cases, candidate Shim selection, and a no-match case.
The Mac gate must establish ordinary API availability and complete monitored resource samples without the two census ps producers. It does not establish browser startup or native authentication.
Keep the owned-zombie cleanup ordering change separately scoped and retain unknown group permissions as failure until a fresh successful probe establishes the state.
apiLimits: The Apple libproc header describes its process-information interfaces as private and subject to change. Pin and check the ABI on the selected runner; no cross-version stability claim is made.
XNU applies MAC policy before libproc same-user checks. Same UID alone does not guarantee access.

KERN_PROCARGS2 may return stale information during exec according to its kernel implementation. Before/after full identity and path checks reduce mixed-generation evidence but do not create an atomic signal operation.
